# app-shell — the reference page, verbatim

The screens every app needs — sign-in, account/settings, notifications, search, and the four data states.

This is the ACTUAL source of a page that renders in the gallery, not a description of one. Copy its
SHAPE — the block composition, the state placement, the derived values — not its content: the brand,
the copy, and the data must all come from the user's brief.

## AppShellPages

```tsx
// REFERENCE PAGE — the APP-SHELL set. Never shipped to a project.
//
// These are the screens every app needs regardless of what it sells: sign-in, account, settings,
// notifications, search results, and the four states a data view can be in. They are authored ONCE
// here on the shared foundation so commerce/dashboard/landing all inherit them — duplicating them per
// category is the maintenance explosion the design pass ruled out.
//
// The single most valuable thing on this page is the STATES row: empty and error side by side. Models
// routinely render "No results" when a fetch actually FAILED, which tells the user to go add data when
// what they should do is retry. Different cause ⇒ different block ⇒ different way out.

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, Bell, CreditCard, LayoutDashboard, RefreshCw, Search, SearchX, Settings, ShieldAlert, User } from 'lucide-react'
import {
	AlertDialog,
	AlertDialogAction,
	AlertDialogCancel,
	AlertDialogContent,
	AlertDialogDescription,
	AlertDialogFooter,
	AlertDialogHeader,
	AlertDialogTitle,
	AlertDialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/components/ui/avatar'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch'
import { AuthCard } from '@/components/blocks/AuthCard'
import { Logo } from '@/components/blocks/Logo'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/blocks/EmptyState'
import { ErrorState } from '@/components/blocks/ErrorState'
import { FilterBar } from '@/components/blocks/FilterBar'
import { AppShell } from '@/components/blocks/AppShell'
import { SettingRow } from '@/components/blocks/SettingRow'
import { SkeletonList } from '@/components/blocks/SkeletonList'

type Section = 'account' | 'notifications' | 'search' | 'states' | 'signin'

const DOCUMENTS = [
	{ id: 'd1', name: 'Q3 revenue model', owner: 'Priya Raman', kind: 'Spreadsheet' },
	{ id: 'd2', name: 'Onboarding rewrite', owner: 'Sam Okafor', kind: 'Doc' },
	{ id: 'd3', name: 'Pricing experiment brief', owner: 'Priya Raman', kind: 'Doc' },
	{ id: 'd4', name: 'Churn cohort analysis', owner: 'Lena Fischer', kind: 'Spreadsheet' },
]

export function AppShellPages() {
	const [section, setSection] = useState<Section>('account')
	const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
	const [kind, setKind] = useState('all')
	const [digest, setDigest] = useState(true)
	const [mentions, setMentions] = useState(true)
	const [marketing, setMarketing] = useState(false)

	// ONE derived list does search AND filter together — never two lists kept in sync (see the data skill).
	const results = useMemo(
		() =>
			DOCUMENTS.filter(
				(d) => (kind === 'all' || d.kind === kind) && (query.trim() === '' || `${d.name} ${d.owner}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase())),
			),
		[query, kind],
	)
	const filtering = query.trim() !== '' || kind !== 'all'
	const clear = () => {
		setQuery('')
		setKind('all')
	}

	// Auth pages carry the brand and NOTHING else — no sidebar, no top bar. So this one view renders
	// outside the shell rather than inside it.
	if (section === 'signin') {
		return (
			<AuthCard
				brand={<Logo name="Meridian" />}
				title="Welcome back"
				subtitle="Sign in to pick up where you left off."
				footer={
					<>
						No account?{' '}
						<button type="button" className="text-foreground underline underline-offset-4" onClick={() => setSection('account')}>
							Create one
						</button>
					</>
				}
			>
				<div className="grid gap-1.5">
					<Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
					<Input id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@company.com" />
				</div>
				<div className="grid gap-1.5">
					<div className="flex items-center justify-between">
						<Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
						<button type="button" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground underline underline-offset-4">
							Forgot?
						</button>
					</div>
					<Input id="password" type="password" />
				</div>
				<Button className="mt-1 w-full">Sign in</Button>
				<Button variant="ghost" className="w-full" onClick={() => setSection('account')}>
					<ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Back to the app
				</Button>
			</AuthCard>
		)
	}

	const nav = (id: Section, label: string, icon: typeof User, badge?: string) => ({
		label,
		icon,
		active: section === id,
		onClick: () => setSection(id),
		badge: badge ? <Badge variant="secondary">{badge}</Badge> : undefined,
	})

	return (
		<AppShell
			brand={<Logo name="Meridian" />}
			groups={[
				{ items: [{ label: 'Overview', icon: LayoutDashboard }, nav('search', 'Search', Search)] },
				{
					heading: 'Account',
					items: [nav('account', 'Profile & settings', Settings), nav('notifications', 'Notifications', Bell, '3'), nav('states', 'States', ShieldAlert)],
				},
			]}
			user={
				<div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
					<Avatar className="size-8">
						<AvatarFallback>PR</AvatarFallback>
					</Avatar>
					<div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
						<span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">Priya Raman</span>
						<button type="button" className="text-left text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={() => setSection('signin')}>
							Sign out
						</button>
					</div>
				</div>
			}
			header={<span className="font-medium">{section === 'account' ? 'Profile & settings' : section === 'notifications' ? 'Notifications' : section === 'search' ? 'Search' : 'States'}</span>}
			headerActions={<Button size="sm">Invite teammate</Button>}
		>
			{section === 'account' ? (
				<div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
					<p className="text-muted-foreground">How you appear to your team, and how the app behaves for you.</p>
					<div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
						<h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Profile</h2>
						<div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
							<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
								<Avatar className="size-14">
									<AvatarFallback className="text-lg">PR</AvatarFallback>
								</Avatar>
								<Button variant="outline" size="sm">
									Change photo
								</Button>
							</div>
							<div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
								<div className="grid gap-1.5">
									<Label htmlFor="name">Full name</Label>
									<Input id="name" defaultValue="Priya Raman" />
								</div>
								<div className="grid gap-1.5">
									<Label htmlFor="work-email">Work email</Label>
									<Input id="work-email" type="email" defaultValue="priya@meridian.co" />
								</div>
							</div>
							<Button className="self-start">Save changes</Button>
						</div>
					</div>
					{/* SettingRow stacked in a divide-y card — label left, control hard right. */}
					<div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
						<h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Preferences</h2>
						<div className="divide-y rounded-xl border bg-card">
							<SettingRow
								label="Theme"
								description="Match your system, or pin one."
								control={
									<Select defaultValue="system">
										<SelectTrigger className="w-36">
											<SelectValue />
										</SelectTrigger>
										<SelectContent>
											<SelectItem value="system">System</SelectItem>
											<SelectItem value="light">Light</SelectItem>
											<SelectItem value="dark">Dark</SelectItem>
										</SelectContent>
									</Select>
								}
							/>
							<SettingRow label="Compact rows" description="Fit more into tables and lists." control={<Switch />} />
							<SettingRow
								label="Billing"
								description="Team plan · renews 4 March"
								control={
									<Button variant="outline" size="sm">
										<CreditCard className="size-4" /> Manage
									</Button>
								}
							/>
						</div>
					</div>
					{/* A destructive action is separated and labelled — never a red button among ordinary ones —
					    AND it confirms. An irreversible action behind a single click is a bug, not a style
					    choice: <AlertDialog> exists for exactly this, and unlike <Dialog> it traps focus on
					    the safe option and cannot be dismissed by clicking the backdrop. */}
					<div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
						<h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Danger zone</h2>
						<div className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/40 bg-card">
							<SettingRow
								label="Delete account"
								description="Removes your profile and every document you own. This cannot be undone."
								control={
									<AlertDialog>
										<AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
											<Button variant="destructive" size="sm">
												Delete
											</Button>
										</AlertDialogTrigger>
										<AlertDialogContent>
											<AlertDialogHeader>
												{/* Name the CONSEQUENCE, not the mechanism: say what disappears and that it is permanent. */}
												<AlertDialogTitle>Delete your account?</AlertDialogTitle>
												<AlertDialogDescription>
													This permanently removes your profile and the 4 documents you own. Teammates lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
												</AlertDialogDescription>
											</AlertDialogHeader>
											<AlertDialogFooter>
												{/* Cancel is the DEFAULT-focused action; the destructive one is never the easy path. */}
												<AlertDialogCancel>Keep my account</AlertDialogCancel>
												<AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Delete everything</AlertDialogAction>
											</AlertDialogFooter>
										</AlertDialogContent>
									</AlertDialog>
								}
							/>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			) : section === 'notifications' ? (
				<div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
					<p className="text-muted-foreground">What reaches you, and where.</p>
					<div className="divide-y rounded-xl border bg-card">
						<SettingRow label="Weekly digest" description="One summary each Monday morning." control={<Switch checked={digest} onCheckedChange={setDigest} />} />
						<SettingRow label="Mentions" description="When a teammate @-mentions you in a comment." control={<Switch checked={mentions} onCheckedChange={setMentions} />} />
						<SettingRow label="Product news" description="Occasional notes about new features." control={<Switch checked={marketing} onCheckedChange={setMarketing} />} />
					</div>
					<div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
						<h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Recent</h2>
						<div className="divide-y rounded-xl border bg-card">
							{[
								{ who: 'Sam Okafor', what: 'commented on Onboarding rewrite', when: '2h ago', unread: true },
								{ who: 'Lena Fischer', what: 'shared Churn cohort analysis with you', when: 'Yesterday', unread: true },
								{ who: 'Priya Raman', what: 'invited Marco Salas to the team', when: '3 days ago', unread: false },
							].map((n) => (
								<div key={n.what} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-4">
									<Avatar className="size-8">
										<AvatarFallback className="text-xs">
											{n.who
												.split(' ')
												.map((p) => p[0])
												.join('')}
										</AvatarFallback>
									</Avatar>
									<div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
										<p className="text-sm">
											<span className="font-medium">{n.who}</span> {n.what}
										</p>
										<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{n.when}</span>
									</div>
									{n.unread ? <span className="mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-primary" aria-label="Unread" /> : null}
								</div>
							))}
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			) : section === 'search' ? (
				<div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
					<p className="text-muted-foreground">Everything you can reach, in one place.</p>
					<FilterBar
						query={query}
						onQueryChange={setQuery}
						placeholder="Search documents and people…"
						chips={kind !== 'all' ? [{ label: kind, onRemove: () => setKind('all') }] : []}
						onClear={filtering ? clear : undefined}
					>
						<Select value={kind} onValueChange={setKind}>
							<SelectTrigger className="w-40">
								<SelectValue />
							</SelectTrigger>
							<SelectContent>
								<SelectItem value="all">All types</SelectItem>
								<SelectItem value="Doc">Docs</SelectItem>
								<SelectItem value="Spreadsheet">Spreadsheets</SelectItem>
							</SelectContent>
						</Select>
					</FilterBar>
					{/* A filtered list that finds nothing is NOT the same empty as a list with no data: the way
					    out is "clear filters", not "create your first document". */}
					{results.length === 0 ? (
						<EmptyState
							icon={SearchX}
							title={filtering ? 'No matches' : 'Nothing here yet'}
							description={filtering ? 'No document matches those filters.' : 'Documents you create or are shared with will appear here.'}
							action={filtering ? <Button variant="outline" onClick={clear}>Clear filters</Button> : <Button>New document</Button>}
						/>
					) : (
						<div className="divide-y rounded-xl border bg-card">
							{results.map((d) => (
								<div key={d.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4">
									<div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
										<span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{d.name}</span>
										<span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{d.owner}</span>
									</div>
									<Badge variant="secondary">{d.kind}</Badge>
								</div>
							))}
						</div>
					)}
				</div>
			) : (
				<div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
					<p className="text-muted-foreground">What a data view shows when it isn't showing data.</p>
					{/* items-start: each state box keeps its natural height instead of stretching to match the
					    tallest cell in its row — a stretched EmptyState reads as a layout bug. */}
					<div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
						<div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
							<span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Loading — a skeleton in the shape of the content</span>
							<SkeletonList count={3} />
						</div>
						<div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
							<span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Empty — it worked, there is nothing yet</span>
							<EmptyState icon={SearchX} title="No documents yet" description="Create one and it will show up here." action={<Button>New document</Button>} />
						</div>
						<div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
							<span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Error — it failed; the action RETRIES</span>
							<ErrorState
								icon={ShieldAlert}
								title="Couldn't load your documents"
								description="The request timed out. Your work is safe."
								action={
									<Button variant="outline">
										<RefreshCw className="size-4" /> Try again
									</Button>
								}
							/>
						</div>
						<div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
							<span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">404 — the route doesn't exist; the action LEAVES</span>
							<ErrorState code="404" title="We can't find that page" description="It may have been moved or deleted." action={<Button onClick={() => setSection('account')}>Back to the app</Button>} />
						</div>
					</div>
					<div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
						<span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Card grid, loading</span>
						<SkeletonList shape="cards" count={3} />
					</div>
				</div>
			)}
		</AppShell>
	)
}
```
